```
ALERT ScrapeFlapping
  IF changes(up[10m]) > 3

  LABELS {
    severity = "critical"
  }
  ANNOTATIONS {
    summary = "Scrape flapping detected",
    description = "The up metric has changed value more than 3 times in the last 10 minutes."
  }
```

A Prometheus alerting rule named TargetDown that fires when any scrape target's up metric has been 0 for 2 minutes can be written as follows:

```
groups:
- name: TargetDown
  rules:
  - alert: TargetDown
    expr: up == 0
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: Target {{ $labels.instance }} is down
```
